Is there anything better than a really good game? I don't even mean your team has to win. I mean a close one, where it could go either way and you're on the edge of your seat. Your heart's pounding, you're yelling at the TV like the players can hear you, and for a couple of hours nothing else matters. That's the good stuff.

I'll never understand people who say sports are dumb. Dumb? Have you seen the things these athletes can do? They're doing stuff with their bodies that shouldn't be physically possible. And they make it look easy! Meanwhile I pulled a muscle getting off the couch last week. We are not the same.

The community part is what I love most. You go to a bar to watch a game and suddenly you're best friends with twenty strangers. High-fiving people you've never met, sharing nachos, collectively losing your minds over a play. Where else does that happen?

And yeah, the heartbreak is real too. When your team loses a big one it genuinely ruins your week. Is that rational? Absolutely not. Do I care? Also no. That's sports. You sign up for all of it.
